sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time (UTC): 2026-10-14 00:25 UTC. Scope: Daily. Date range: 2026-10-14 through 2026-10-14. Ranking basis: GitHub Trending daily star gains, corroborated with GitHub Search and repository/branch REST endpoints.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Agent-oriented reverse engineering led the snapshot by a wide margin: morluto/rea showed 54,679 stars gained on GitHub Trending at capture time. The rest of the leaders span creative AI, spatial visualization, agent context/design tools, and cross-platform Apple development.

sections.title: morluto/rea
sections.description: An MCP-connected agent toolkit for investigating apps, websites, and native binaries, with evidence-backed findings.
sections.why_notable: Its displayed daily gain dominates this snapshot; its README describes local analysis through MCP/CLI and evidence and limitations attached to conclusions.
sections.content: REA connects agents to local reverse-engineering tools for applications and binaries, returning findings with evidence and stated limitations.

sections.title: storytold/artcraft
sections.description: A visual creative environment for AI image and video making, combining 2D composition, 3D scene staging, and model choice.
sections.why_notable: It is the second-largest daily gain in this capture and frames generative media as an editable visual workflow rather than prompt-only generation.
sections.content: ArtCraft describes an artist-oriented creative IDE with 2D composition, 3D staging, and model selection for image/video generation.

sections.title: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
sections.description: A browser-based 3D globe that layers public live and regularly refreshed geospatial feeds.
sections.why_notable: The README documents a modular globe with aircraft, ships, satellites, weather, and other public feeds, making it a standout open-data visualization project.
sections.unique_caveat: The README says some feeds are refreshed rather than live, traffic is simulated along real roads, and camera poses/launch trajectories are coarse estimates.
sections.content: God's Eye View layers public geospatial feeds onto a browser globe; its README distinguishes live data from simulated or estimated elements.

sections.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
sections.description: An agent skill for producing branded diagrams as self-contained HTML and SVG.
sections.why_notable: Its large daily gain reflects demand for polished, reusable visual outputs in agent workflows; the README describes many diagram types and cross-agent installation.
sections.content: Diagram Design turns natural-language diagram requests into standalone HTML/SVG outputs and can be installed across several agent hosts.

sections.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio
sections.description: A local-first desktop suite for voice cloning/design, transcription, dubbing, and audiobook production.
sections.why_notable: The README combines an extensible speech-engine workflow with optional local hardware acceleration, desktop production tools, and an API/MCP interface.
sections.content: VoiceStudio is an Electron desktop app with voice workflows, a selectable speech-engine catalog, local hardware acceleration options, and API/MCP support.

sections.title: xtool-org/xtool
sections.description: A cross-platform Xcode alternative for building and deploying iOS apps with SwiftPM.
sections.why_notable: It brings Apple-platform build workflows to Linux and Windows, a distinct developer-tooling theme among the leaders.
sections.content: xtool aims to build and deploy iOS projects with SwiftPM on macOS, Linux, and Windows.

sections.title: lyogavin/airllm
sections.description: An inference project focused on running very large language models with limited GPU memory.
sections.why_notable: Its daily gain points to continuing interest in reducing the hardware barrier to local LLM inference.
sections.content: AirLLM focuses on LLM inference under tight GPU-memory constraints; actual feasibility depends on the model and hardware.

sections.title: mksglu/context-mode
sections.description: A context-management layer for coding agents that routes tool calls and reduces tool-output/context overhead.
sections.why_notable: It targets a practical scaling bottleneck in multi-tool coding agents: noisy outputs and limited context windows.
sections.content: Context-mode positions itself as context-window optimization and tool routing for coding agents.

sections.title: vercel-labs/skills
sections.description: An open CLI for discovering and installing agent skills.
sections.why_notable: It represents an emerging distribution layer for reusable agent capabilities, though its displayed daily gain is lower than the other listed projects.
sections.content: Vercel's skills repository supplies an open command-line tool for agent-skill discovery and installation.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent-connected developer tools: REA, context-mode, vercel-labs/skills, and diagram-design connect agents to specialized inspection, context-management, reusable skills, or visual-output workflows. Creative AI with more user control: ArtCraft emphasizes visual composition and 3D staging; VoiceStudio packages voice creation and media production in a desktop workflow; AirLLM addresses constrained local inference. Live/open-data visualization: God's Eye View brings multiple public geospatial feeds into a browser globe, with source caveats described in its README. Language mix: TypeScript 3; JavaScript, Python, HTML, Rust, Swift, and Jupyter Notebook 1 each across these nine repositories.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The strongest signal is the scale of REA's displayed one-day gain, with a second tier of interest in agent workflow infrastructure and creative AI tools. Alongside that, contributors are also drawing attention to accessible local inference, public-data visualization, and cross-platform development beyond Apple's standard toolchain.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary: GitHub Trending at 2026-10-14 00:25 UTC. Corroboration: GitHub REST repository/default-branch endpoints and Search API exact-name queries for all nine repositories; current README files checked for the five narration-priority repositories. Daily ranks use GitHub Trending displayed star gains. This is an early-day snapshot; no prior-window comparison is claimed.
